comment: Hardware families the project wants tester reports from (docs/usage/hardware-we-need.md, rendered by scripts/docs/generate-hardware-reports.py). package: macos, container, sycl, cuda, hip, windows, windows-cuda, windows-sycl. state: ids of docs/state.md rows the family closes. owner: the project host that covers the family, or null. match: how a report under docs/hardware-reports/ counts for the family (platform, machine, flags_all, flags_none, cpu_model_re for host; gpu_backend and gpu_families for a GPU device, with platform to count only one platform's reports). The generator refuses a GPU family of the row maps in tools/rc1-tester/image/ that no row here lists, and a state id that is not in docs/state.md.

rows.family: Apple M-series, native (M1 to M4 Macs)
Arm without SVE2 (Apple M-series under Docker Desktop, Graviton 2, Ampere Altra, Raspberry Pi 4 and 5)
Arm with SVE2 (AWS Graviton 4, Azure Cobalt 100, Google Axion)
Intel with AVX-512 (Xeon Skylake-SP to Sapphire Rapids and later, Core 11th generation)
AMD with AVX-512 (Zen 4 and Zen 5: Ryzen 7000 and 9000, EPYC 9004 and 9005)
x86 with AVX2 and no AVX-512 (Intel Core 12th to 14th generation, AMD Zen 2 and Zen 3)
Windows on x64 (Intel and AMD processors; AVX-512 where the processor has it)
Windows on Arm (Snapdragon X and other Arm laptops)
NVIDIA Ampere (A100, GeForce RTX 30 series, RTX A-series)
NVIDIA Hopper (H100, H200)
NVIDIA Blackwell (B200, GeForce RTX 50 series, Jetson Thor, DGX Spark)
NVIDIA Ada (GeForce RTX 40 series)
NVIDIA GPU under native Windows (GeForce RTX 30 series or newer, RTX professional cards)
AMD CDNA (Instinct MI100, MI200, MI300, MI350)
AMD RDNA3 and RDNA3.5 (Radeon RX 7000, Radeon 780M, 860M, 890M, 8060S)
AMD RDNA4 (Radeon RX 9060 and RX 9070, AI PRO R9700)
AMD RDNA1 (Radeon RX 5700, RX 5600, RX 5500)
AMD RDNA2 (Radeon RX 6000, Steam Deck, Ryzen 7000 graphics)
